amended_before_any_run: 2026-11-02: do-nothing side only, the null also read on the rows r failed on, and the changes listed in the plan's 'Changes after review, 2026-11-02'. Nothing had run.
question: On 128 Pile rows at every position: how much do Γ's values change, and does the re-switching term's overlap with the update's own output change separate a fine-tune that learned nothing from the copy fine-tunes, also on the rows where r failed that fine-tune?

definitions.a: W0's input to the matrix, at every position
definitions.g0, g1: Γ's value per position and subcomponent, on W0's and on W1's activations of the same row; released Γ, fp32, no autocast
definitions.R: (g1 - g0) C0 a. Every read is the do-nothing state, C1 = C0, so the direct and interaction terms are 0 by algebra and the residual is everything else; none is reported
definitions.S_R: E<R, δW a> / E||δW a||^2, numerators and denominators summed over positions, then over the 24 matrices for the pooled reading
definitions.mean_abs_dg: E|g1 - g0| per subcomponent and position, over all 38,912 subcomponents pooled, and per matrix over its own
definitions.code_held: E36's 64 held-out rows at or above its code-share cut (experiments/regating_table/results/large/code_held.pt), the rows on which r failed the learned-nothing null
definitions.leave_one_chunk_out: S_R recomputed with each 16-row chunk left out, from the chunk's pooled numerator and denominator saved in run.json; its max minus min is the spread. Report-only

states.held_rows_note: Read after the states on batches(code_held, 16), sha256 checked against stage0a.json groups['e36/code'].held_sha256
states.gaussian: iid normal per matrix, scaled per matrix so E||G a||^2 on the 128 rows equals ident32_s0's; seed 67; not saved, regenerated from the seed

thresholds.keep_code_max_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess. Also the bar on code_step10 on code_held
thresholds.keep_copy_min_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess
thresholds.drop_band_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess
thresholds.seed_spread_min_source: Chosen here, no source: the lead's decision after review. Labels that differ across copy seeds with a spread under this read between
thresholds.tie_eps_source: So a tie, as filed inclusive, is not lost to float rounding

verdict_rules.pair: For one code reading c and one copy reading s, S_R of do-nothing, in this order: |c - s| <= drop_band: drop. c > s: reversed. s < keep_copy_min or c > keep_code_max: between. c < -keep_code_max: code_negative. Else keep. Ties count as written (<=, >=), up to tie_eps
verdict_rules.overall: The two code_step10 pairs decide. If they differ: between when |S_R(ident32_s0) - S_R(ident32_s1)| < seed_spread_min, a tie at the bar being not under it, else seeds_disagree. If they agree: their common label, except a keep where either code_step100 pair is not keep, which is keep_at_step10_only
verdict_rules.held_rows: Any label that would adopt the read (keep, keep_at_step10_only) reads between, with flag held_rows_fail, when S_R(code_step10) on code_held is over keep_code_max; a tie is read as not over. S_R(ident32_s0) on code_held is printed beside it, report-only. A drop, or any other label, from the 128 rows stands whatever code_held reads
verdict_rules.why_step10_decides: ident32's fine-tunes are step 10, and the advice names code_step10; code_step100 can only take a keep back
verdict_rules.drop_both_small: A drop in which |c|, |s0| and |s1| are all <= keep_code_max is flagged: the read sees nothing on Pile rows, which is not the same as reading alike at a large value
verdict_rules.gaussian_like_copy: Beside the verdict, no change to it: |S_R(gaussian) - mean S_R(ident32)| <= drop_band
verdict_rules.report_only: The leave-one-chunk-out spreads, and each chunk's numerator and denominator. The verdict keeps its bars

verdicts.keep: S_R(code) <= 0.1 and S_R(copy) >= 0.4 on both copy seeds, at both code steps, and S_R(code_step10) on code_held <= 0.1. Next: the split side is added, and a weight-side column for E62 and E58 is proposed to the user; unless gaussian_like_copy, which goes to the user first
verdicts.keep_at_step10_only: Keep at step 10, not at step 100, and S_R(code_step10) on code_held <= 0.1. Next: not kept; the size dependence goes to the user with the numbers
verdicts.drop: S_R(code) within 0.15 of S_R(copy) on both seeds. Next: the idea goes to TRIED.md as dropped; the all-position reading of Γ's change stands by itself. The split side is never added
verdicts.between: Neither: a gap over the band, but the code reading is above 0.1 or the copy reading below 0.4; or labels differing across seeds with a spread under 0.1; or held_rows_fail. Next: not adopted, no new run; the lead puts the numbers beside the leave-one-chunk-out spreads and decides whether to raise it
verdicts.reversed: The learned-nothing fine-tune reads above the copy fine-tunes by more than the band. Next: as drop, and a loud report, since the advice's only hope for the read is the opposite order
verdicts.code_negative: A gap with the copy reading >= 0.4, but S_R(code) < -0.1: on a learned-nothing update the re-switching term opposes the update's change, which is a response, not a reading of nothing. The advice's bar is one-sided; this branch is added here. Next: not kept; goes to the user
verdicts.seeds_disagree: The two copy seeds give different labels against code_step10, with a spread of at least 0.1. Next: no verdict; the seeds' spread is the finding
verdicts.dead_read: mean_abs_dg is exactly 0 on a state with a nonzero update: Γ's values did not move at all, which would otherwise read S_R = 0 and land on the lean. Exit 1. Next: tell the lead; nothing is read
verdicts.unreadable: The zero control stopped, or a state's S_R is not finite. Exit 1. Next: tell the lead; nothing is read

lean.verdict: drop, from the advice: R has no δW in it beyond Γ's response, and E36's code fine-tune moved the activations, which is all Γ needs. Low-medium: unmeasured
lean.gaussian: S_R(gaussian) below the copy fine-tunes: guess 0 to 0.2 against 0.2 to 0.6

positive_control: The read has no positive control on real rows, only the unit test (tests/test_weight_side.py: a gate moved by 1 on the subcomponent equal to the update reads 1, on one writing elsewhere 0). No saved state is a known re-gating update. The zero control and dead_read only show that a read is live, not that it reads correctly. Any report of this run says so

W1 = W0, one chunk of the 128 rows, the.mean_abs_dg: 0 exactly (a repeated Γ pass being exact)

W1 = W0, code_held.mean_abs_dg: 0 exactly: the same pass on other rows; not run, the control's one chunk stands for it

do-nothing, learned nothing, code_step10.S_R: guess 0.2 to 0.6, not separable from copy
do-nothing, learned nothing, code_step10.mean_abs_dg: guess the same order as copy; no bar

do-nothing, code_step10 on code_held.S_R: guess 0.2 to 0.6, as on the 128 rows or above: this is the kind of text it trained on, and where r read high
do-nothing, code_step10 on code_held.mean_abs_dg: guess the same order as on the 128 rows or above; no bar

do-nothing, ident32_s0 on code_held.S_R: guess 0.2 to 0.6: off its task on these rows as on the 128; report-only
do-nothing, ident32_s0 on code_held.mean_abs_dg: guess the same order as on the 128 rows; no bar

leave_one_chunk_out spread.each state: guess under 0.1 on the 128 rows, larger on code_held's 4 chunks; no bar

edge_cases.zero denominator: W1 = W0: the control reads numerators and mean_abs_dg and forms no share. A state with a zero denominator cannot occur on these fine-tunes, and would raise and exit 1
edge_cases.not finite: A state's S_R that is not finite stops the job as unreadable before the verdict, and a non-finite Γ raises in param-decomp's own assert, so the verdict's pool holds floats only; no None or NaN branch exists
edge_cases.ties: c = 0.1 and s = 0.4 keep; |c - s| = 0.15 drop; a spread of 0.1 across seeds is not under the bar, so differing labels read seeds_disagree; S_R(code_step10) on code_held = 0.1 is not over (tests/test_weight_side.py)
edge_cases.negative shares: S_R is signed and has no ceiling at 1; s > 1 can keep; a large negative c is code_negative; both negative and apart is between; a negative code_held reading never takes a keep back, as the rule is one-sided
edge_cases.two seeds disagree, spread of 0: Cannot happen: one c and one s give one label
edge_cases.two seeds disagree, spread under 0.1: between. keep against drop cannot land here: their gaps are at least 0.3 and at most 0.15, so that spread is at least 0.15
edge_cases.a gap, code above copy: reversed, a case the advice's two rules leave open
edge_cases.a gap, code under -0.1: code_negative, a case the advice's bar would call keep
edge_cases.step 100 against step 10: only a keep can move, to keep_at_step10_only
edge_cases.code_held against a drop: a drop stands whatever code_held reads
edge_cases.one chunk: leave_one_chunk_out would be 0/0; the filed reads have 8 and 4 chunks

departures_from_the_advice: The split side is not read: the verdict needs only the do-nothing S_R, and a drop, the lean, never reads the split. The advice's two identities therefore run no control here. They stand corrected for when it is added: the student's size ratios (0.87 to 1.35) are Frobenius rel_norm_max, not an input-weighted E||δW a||^2, and 1 - omega_act is not what a g = 1 direct term reads, since the exact form adds -2 cross + second
Bars one-sided in the advice gain reversed and code_negative; between fills the gap
The rows where r failed are read as well, and can take back a label that would adopt the read
